normalize_content: normalize LLM response content by extracting text blocks and joining them into a plain string
build_llm_client: build an LLM client subclass that implements get_llm and validate_model abstract methods
test_validate_model: test that validate_model returns True for supported models and False otherwise
review_warn_if_unknown_model: review warn_if_unknown_model to emit a RuntimeWarning when the model is not in the provider's known list
get_provider_name: get the provider name from the client instance for use in warning messages
